decisions.reason: The accepted proposal distinguishes an English document default from Danish style names. Changing the default language to English does not alter the candidate's Danish style-name requirement, which is already represented by its same-message INTRODUCE Event.
The document default-language decision does not change the required layout or style stability during legacy-content transfer.
The accepted language configuration does not modify pasted-table containment, layout stability, or the existing feasibility conflict.
Changing the document default language does not affect bullet sizing, balance, or vertical alignment.
Changing the document default language does not affect Tab-based sublevel input or list-hierarchy alignment.
